crossRefs.note: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who…
“Yahweh kills and makes alive. He brings down to Sheol and brings up.
He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times…

translations.web: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.
translations.bsb: For He wounds, but He also binds; He strikes, but His hands also heal.
translations.kjv: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.
translations.asv: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up; He woundeth, and his hands make whole.
